consequence.statement: A new optional field, refreshPolicy (CreatedOnce, Periodic or OnChange), is now available under spec.externalSecretSpec. Existing ClusterExternalSecret resources need no change.

assertion.statement: Between chart 0.15.0 and 0.16.0, the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret schema gained a new optional field, spec.externalSecretSpec.refreshPolicy. It controls how the generated ExternalSecret is refreshed: CreatedOnce, Periodic or OnChange.
